completedTasks.title: MCP server declarations per stack feature
completedTasks.summary: Added mcp-servers.json per stack for declaring recommended MCP servers. Scaffold collects, merges (externalTools > stack > common), and writes to agent-specific configs: .mcp.json (Claude/Hermes/Junie), ~/.hermes/config.yaml (Hermes user-scoped), ~/.claude/settings.json (Claude user-scoped), .github/copilot/mcp-config.json (Copilot). 48 new tests, 590 total passing.
